blind.description: A traditional wooden butter churn consisting of a slightly tapered wooden stave barrel bound by three dark metal hoops, a fitted round wooden lid, and a central vertical wooden dasher handle topped with a spherical knob. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and styled with light brown wood grain textures and dark metallic bands, standing firmly on its flat base.
blind.from_above: A circular brown wooden top with subtle radial plank divisions, centered around a small spherical knob handle, surrounded by the slight perimeter outline of the wider base hoop, casting an elongated shadow of the barrel and dasher handle.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 40% as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (approx. 2.2 to 2.5 ft tall including the handle) and about 1 ft in diameter at the base.
